GODZILLA MINUS ZERO
VFX, Written, and Directed by Takashi Yamazaki
In theatres November 6
Follow @godzilla_toho and @GKIDSfilms for more updates!
godzillaminuszero.com

War reduced Japan to zero, and Godzilla plunged it into minus. Two years have passed since then, and the country has faced agonizing struggles to achieve recovery and finally reclaim its daily life.

Just as humanity managed to cling to a hard-won peace, a new threat strikes, crushing hope in an instant.
 
There is no third time. Everything ends here.

Shot entirely in Japan as the first-ever Japanese production to be Filmed For IMAX, GODZILLA MINUS ZERO was shot with high-definition digital cameras certified by IMAX, and optimized in sound and imagery unique to IMAX screens. trending_videos.title: Gorr: The God Butcher | Character Reveal Trailer | Marvel Rivals
trending_videos.description:
The unholy crusader is ready to slay the gods. Gorr the God Butcher has arrived! 💀  

The terrifying God Butcher has revealed his true form after defeating two deities back-to-back, and he's hungry for more. Once a deeply devout believer, the loss of his faith in the gods warped his will into a honed weapon with singular purpose.  

Gorr relentlessly executes his enemies while wielding the first symbiote, All-Black the Necrosword. His living sword absorbs the flesh of his enemies, and converting them into his army of Black Berserkers. While commanding his berserkers to crush his foes, he can travel across the battlefield to strike at the most unexpected angles until he unleashes the true power of the Annihilablade.  

The gods will be eradicated one by one as Gorr brings hatred to the battlefield on September 11 (UTC)!  ⚔️

trending_videos.title: Remain | Official Teaser
trending_videos.description:
She's unlike anybody he's ever met. From M. Night Shyamalan, #RemainMovie is in theaters Valentine's Day 2027.

From Warner Bros. Pictures, Remain, starring Jake Gyllenhaal, is an unprecedented collaboration between two of the world’s most creative minds: best-selling author Nicholas Sparks, and visionary filmmaker M. Night Shyamalan.

When reclusive architect Tate Gordon moves to small coastal town to complete his latest project, he encounters an alluring young woman who pulls him out of his shell, and into the center of a deadly mystery that hangs over the town.

Gyllenhaal stars alongside Phoebe Dynevor, Ashley Walters, Julie Hagerty and Jay O. Sanders.

Shyamalan directs from his own screenplay, story by Shyamalan and Sparks. The film is produced by Shyamalan, Ashwin Rajan, Marc Bienstock and Theresa Park, with Sparks executive producing.

Joining Shyamalan behind the camera are director of photography Adolpho Veloso, production designer Sam Lisenco, editor Noëmi Preiswerk, costume
